02 / Spatial blueprint

Room requirements

A compact clinical footprint can be adapted to a standard consultation room or underutilized OPD area.

ParameterRecommended specificationMinimum operational threshold
Ideal room size300 sq. ft. · 2 dental chairs150 sq. ft. · 1 dental chair
Ceiling height9–10 ft8.5 ft
Electrical15A dedicated lines + UPS backupStandard hospital power + backup
Plumbing½″ water inlet + 1.5–2″ drainageWall / under-floor conduit routing
KEY TAKEAWAY

The minimal footprint enables straightforward conversion of standard consultation rooms or underutilized OPD areas.

03 / Equipment footprint

Clinical essentials, thoughtfully integrated.

Every core component is selected around clinical efficiency, ergonomics and a clean patient journey.

01 / CORE UNIT

Dental chair

180–200 cm fully reclined · 90–110 cm wide · 1.5 m working clearance.

02 / AUXILIARY

Compressor

Oil-free 1.5–2 HP · approx. 2′ × 2′ footprint · noise-insulated cabinet.

03 / CLINICAL

Suction

Medical-grade wet/dry suction integrated into the clinical workflow.

04 / STERILIZATION

Autoclave

Class B tabletop sterilizer · approx. 2.5 ft counter space.

05 / IMAGING

Imaging

Wall-mounted intraoral X-ray + RVG · minimal floor footprint.

06 / WORKFLOW

Ergonomics

Mobile doctor and assistant stools · clean circulation around the chair.
